name: aidevobserver
description: Review your AI coding session for reinvention / waste — a thin editor surface over the Teleon Observer CLI. Governed candidates (serves_truth=false), read-only. Works in VS Code and Cursor.

aidevobserver.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter used to run the Teleon Observer CLI (`<python> -m src.teleon.observer.cli ...`).

aidevobserver.cliCwd.description: Working directory the observer CLI runs in. Empty = the first workspace folder, so the CLI discovers THAT project's Claude sessions.

aidevobserver.autoReviewOnFocus.description: When the editor regains focus, silently refresh the status-bar finding count for the latest session.

aidevobserver.apiKey.markdownDescription: Bring-your-own API key for the optional remote backend. Used only when no workspace folder is open: it is sent as `byo_key` with the `/run` request and used transiently by the endpoint for that one call. The extension does not persist or log it beyond this VS Code setting.

aidevobserver.endpoint.description: URL of the byo_demo_server /run endpoint used as a fallback (no workspace folder open) to review the active editor's transcript via {demo, byo_key, inputs}.
